content.rationale: The diff correctly replaces the erroneous subtraction of the raw percentage with an integer-cents discount calculation. The new logic computes (subtotal_cents * discount_percent) // 100 and subtracts it from the subtotal, which satisfies the failing test expectation (20000, 10 -> 18000) and the zero-discount and invalid-percentage cases. No new defects are introduced.
